Maya Tran: Quick note — May launch dashboard shows DAU->MQL rate flattening after day 7 at ~1.2%. looks off vs benchmarks :thinking_face:
Evan Cole: saw that. could be real funnel drop or an attribution shift. which window did you use?
Maya Tran: pulseboard default 7-day cohort. lead routing/CRM uses 14-day lookback for partners, so labels might differ
Jorge Rivas: can you paste the query? i'll diff against leadflow and crm labels
Maya Tran: snippet: ```SELECT cohort_day, count(distinct user_id) AS mqls FROM events WHERE event='mql' AND launch_id='may_release' GROUP BY cohort_day ORDER BY cohort_day;```
Leah Park: Heads up — we rolled a backfill last week that maps some partners using utm_content instead of utm_campaign. that will reshuffle CRM counts
Tom B: that backfill would create a mismatch between raw event feed and CRM-backed dashboards. pulseboard reads raw events currently
ops-bot: leadflow-sync finished at 2026-03-22T09:23:12Z (7,200 records processed)
Evan Cole: action plan: 1) isolate organic/no-UTM cohort, 2) compare raw-event vs crm-backfilled series for paid/social
Jorge Rivas: running diff now. will export CSV with both series in ~20m
Leah Park: also check webinar registrants — saw a redirect that strips query params so registrants appear as `direct` instead of `email_campaign`
Maya Tran: that would move high-intent leads out of email cohort and lower visible conversion
Tom B: can we add a pulseboard metadata flag for recent routing/backfill changes? even a small annotation would help weekly reviewers
Evan Cole: +1. also a toggle to display raw vs crm-backed series would be useful
Jorge Rivas: diff results: raw-events show the day-8 dip; crm-backfilled shows partial recovery. delta concentrated in paid/social and partner X
Maya Tran: looks attribution-driven. next: Leah to pull session traces for 200 impacted user_ids to confirm timing
Leah Park: on it — will report whether conversions occurred after day 7
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "post-launch attribution sanity" 2026-03-22T10:10:00Z (30m)
Maya Tran: prep before meeting: Jorge upload CSV, Leah session traces, Evan add dashboard annotation + PM blurb, Tom scope metadata toggle
Tom B: will add metadata toggle and UI switch for raw vs crm-backed today (low effort)
Evan Cole: i'll draft a 2-bullet exec note with link to CSV
Jorge Rivas: CSV uploaded to marketing assets: https://redwood.internal/files/may_launch_attrib_delta_334455.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maya Tran: thanks team. long-term: add an "attribution parity" test in weekly KPI report and a webinar redirect checklist pre-launch
Evan Cole: noted. meeting in 45. :thumbsup:
